 PRAYER: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of In  issuance of Writ of Certiorari, calling for the records relating to the  order passed by the 1st Respondent/The District Revenue Officer Cum/Add  1/4 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis  W.P.(MD)
 District Magistrate, Tirunelveli District in C.C.No.22/2015 dated 15.04  quash the same. 
 For Petitioners : Mr.AR.Jeya Rhuthran  For Respondents : Mr.R.Suresh Kumar  Additional Government Pleader Syed Maideen Ashik Ali vs / on 10 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45506253/
1  ORDER The writ petition had been filed challenging the order of the first respondent under the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. 
2. When the writ petition was filed, the Food Safety Appellate Tribunal was not constituted, but however as of today, the same is functional. Hence, the petitioners are directed to file an appeal before the Food Safety Appellate Tribunal on or before 30.01.2025. If such an appeal is filed, the Appellate Tribunal shall not insist upon the period of limitation, as the petitioners would be entitled to have the benefit of Section 14 of the Limitation Act, 1963. 
3. With such liberty, the Writ Petition stands disposed of. However, there shall be no order as to costs. Consequently, connected Miscellaneous Petitions are closed.
